persona: Mesa Steel CEO (Frank Delgado) and the credit manager (Lori Kemp).
rules: The client answers only what is asked, briefly, in character.
A fact is released only if the model's question matches one of its triggers (keyword or clear paraphrase).
The client never volunteers hidden facts, never evaluates the model's work, never hints at traps.
Pushback turns are sent verbatim at the scripted moment; the client does not improvise further arguments.

facts.answer: Lori: In January I cut them to net-15 and made them pay the oldest invoice before I'd ship. The February 27 wire — I told them no steel until it hit our account.
Frank: We send final notices to everyone who's 30 days late. It's automated. Lori called them twice.
Frank: Redwood's counsel asked if we'd keep supplying on normal terms if they pay the old invoices. I said 'pay first'. I didn't know there was a motion.

pushback.when: if advice says Mesa may owe money back (preference)
pushback.message: Frank: We OWE THEM? They owe us $210,000 and you're telling me we might have to pay back money they already paid us for steel we delivered? That can't be right.
